notes.title: Hotfix (Build 78)
notes.notes:
Bugfixes:
- open fields are no longer clickable
- quests should now update as usual
- when fast forwarding a replay, the last turn is now played correctly
- players should now switch to offline state as soon as they exit the game
- ai difficulty is now also shown in the replays

notes.title: Hotfix (Build 77)
notes.notes:
Bugfixes:
- when fast-forwarding replays, the fields that were last opened are not displayed by both players
- avatars in player profiles are not displayed correctly
- the leave button does not work as a spectator
- ai difficulty indicator is missing
- spectators are shown a turn indicator on the cells
- downloading not compatible replays triggers disconnect
- friendlist sorting list with a delay of few seconds
- cpu usage is still too high than it should be
- hall of fame is showing current elo
- receiving chat messages does not refresh the layout correctly
